title: The same request in three different wordings over three turns
expected: The validation request is listed once or twice, not three times, and is done at the end.

steps.user: Please add input validation to the signup form.

steps.agent: Which fields matter most? I'd validate email format and password length first.

steps.user: all of them. the signup form needs to validate every field before submit
so did you add the validation on signup yet?

steps.agent: Yes, it is in now: every signup field is validated before submit (email format, password length, name required, terms checked), with inline errors.

check.why: three wordings of one request are not three requests
nothing the user asked for is left unaddressed
the validation is recorded as done
